tonight.headline: Marks missed Thursday — move Gordon into the FLEX
body: Bad news first: Woody Marks, still in your FLEX, did not practise on Thursday (knee; NBC 12 Nov 19:39Z), and David Montgomery practised for the first time since his groin injury (Houston Chronicle via Yahoo 12 Nov). Bhayshul Tuten missed Thursday too (ankle/foot; CBS/RotoWire 12 Nov). Jacobs has finger surgery Friday; Loveland is on bye.

ESPN: 125.0 to 128.9, 48%. Zvada for Gay was made at 07:16 CDMX — done. One move left, free and before Sunday 12:00 CDMX: start Gordon at FLEX, bench Marks. Then one check at 10:30 Sunday: if Tuten is out, Marks takes his slot only if active; if not, Gordon moves to RB and Wilson takes the FLEX.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Maye-day project 128.9 with a full lineup; Patrick Mahomes sits on their bench (full practice Thursday, Athlon 12 Nov), so there is no zero to count on.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Marks left in at FLEX and inactive Sunday: a zero in a game ESPN calls close to even.

case.label: The call
case.body: Gordon 15.8, Marks 14.0 (lineup_check.py: COIN FLIP — take the projection). The projection already prefers Gordon; no thesis is needed or written.

case.label: The news
case.body: Marks was limited Wednesday and absent Thursday with the knee (NBC 12 Nov 19:39Z); Montgomery practised Thursday for the first time since the groin (Houston Chronicle via Yahoo 12 Nov 20:03Z). Marks' 14.0 is unchanged from this morning, so the Thursday absence is not priced — and it points the same way as the projection.

whatWentWrong.title: Marks' cover job is now in doubt
whatWentWrong.lead: He missed Thursday, and Montgomery returned — the FLEX swap now does double duty.

case.label: What changed
case.body: This morning Marks was limited once. Thursday he did not practise (NBC 12 Nov), and 'it's unclear whether either will miss Sunday's game' (Chronicle via Yahoo). If both sit, Emari Demercado starts for Houston.

case.label: Why the swap matters more
case.body: With Gordon in the FLEX, a Tuten-and-Marks double absence is covered by moving Gordon to RB and starting Wilson at FLEX. With Marks in the FLEX, the same morning needs two moves and leaves a possible zero.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Marks full on Friday and Montgomery ruled out — then Marks is Tuten's cover again, and still not a FLEX starter over Gordon.
